# kreuzcrawl v0.2.0 - Table of Contents

High-performance web crawling engine

## Modules

- [Kreuzcrawl](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.md): High-level API for kreuzcrawl.
- [Kreuzcrawl.ActionResult](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.ActionResult.md): Result from a single page action execution.
- [Kreuzcrawl.ArticleMetadata](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.ArticleMetadata.md): Article metadata extracted from `article:*` Open Graph tags.
- [Kreuzcrawl.AssetCategory](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.AssetCategory.md): The category of a downloaded asset.
- [Kreuzcrawl.AuthConfig](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.AuthConfig.md): Authentication configuration.
- [Kreuzcrawl.BatchCrawlResult](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.BatchCrawlResult.md): Result from a single URL in a batch crawl operation.
- [Kreuzcrawl.BatchScrapeResult](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.BatchScrapeResult.md): Result from a single URL in a batch scrape operation.
- [Kreuzcrawl.BrowserConfig](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.BrowserConfig.md): Browser fallback configuration.
- [Kreuzcrawl.BrowserMode](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.BrowserMode.md): When to use the headless browser fallback.
- [Kreuzcrawl.BrowserWait](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.BrowserWait.md): Wait strategy for browser page rendering.
- [Kreuzcrawl.CachedPage](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.CachedPage.md): Cached page data for HTTP response caching.
- [Kreuzcrawl.CitationResult](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.CitationResult.md): Result of citation conversion.
- [Kreuzcrawl.ContentConfig](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.ContentConfig.md): Content extraction and conversion configuration.
- [Kreuzcrawl.CookieInfo](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.CookieInfo.md): Information about an HTTP cookie received from a response.
- [Kreuzcrawl.CrawlConfig](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.CrawlConfig.md): Configuration for crawl, scrape, and map operations.
- [Kreuzcrawl.CrawlEvent](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.CrawlEvent.md): An event emitted during a streaming crawl operation.
- [Kreuzcrawl.CrawlPageResult](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.CrawlPageResult.md): The result of crawling a single page during a crawl operation.
- [Kreuzcrawl.CrawlResult](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.CrawlResult.md): The result of a multi-page crawl operation.
- [Kreuzcrawl.DownloadedAsset](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.DownloadedAsset.md): A downloaded asset from a page.
- [Kreuzcrawl.DownloadedDocument](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.DownloadedDocument.md): A downloaded non-HTML document (PDF, DOCX, image, code file, etc.).
- [Kreuzcrawl.ExtractionMeta](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.ExtractionMeta.md): Metadata about an LLM extraction pass.
- [Kreuzcrawl.FaviconInfo](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.FaviconInfo.md): Information about a favicon or icon link.
- [Kreuzcrawl.FeedInfo](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.FeedInfo.md): Information about a feed link found on a page.
- [Kreuzcrawl.FeedType](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.FeedType.md): The type of a feed (RSS, Atom, or JSON Feed).
- [Kreuzcrawl.HeadingInfo](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.HeadingInfo.md): A heading element extracted from the page.
- [Kreuzcrawl.HreflangEntry](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.HreflangEntry.md): An hreflang alternate link entry.
- [Kreuzcrawl.ImageInfo](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.ImageInfo.md): Information about an image found on a page.
- [Kreuzcrawl.ImageSource](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.ImageSource.md): The source of an image reference.
- [Kreuzcrawl.InteractionResult](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.InteractionResult.md): Result of executing a sequence of page interaction actions.
- [Kreuzcrawl.JsonLdEntry](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.JsonLdEntry.md): A JSON-LD structured data entry found on a page.
- [Kreuzcrawl.LinkInfo](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.LinkInfo.md): Information about a link found on a page.
- [Kreuzcrawl.LinkType](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.LinkType.md): The classification of a link.
- [Kreuzcrawl.MapResult](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.MapResult.md): The result of a map operation, containing discovered URLs.
- [Kreuzcrawl.MarkdownResult](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.MarkdownResult.md): Rich markdown conversion result from HTML processing.
- [Kreuzcrawl.PageMetadata](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.PageMetadata.md): Metadata extracted from an HTML page's `<meta>` tags and `<title>` element.
- [Kreuzcrawl.ProxyConfig](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.ProxyConfig.md): Proxy configuration for HTTP requests.
- [Kreuzcrawl.ResponseMeta](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.ResponseMeta.md): Response metadata extracted from HTTP headers.
- [Kreuzcrawl.ScrapeResult](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.ScrapeResult.md): The result of a single-page scrape operation.
- [Kreuzcrawl.SitemapUrl](https://kreuzcrawl.hexdocs.pm/Kreuzcrawl.SitemapUrl.md): A URL entry from a sitemap.
